trip.title: Seoul → Busan → Seoul (Hongdae)
trip.subtitle: Sixteen days, three neighborhood bases, room to wander.
trip.date_note: Working calendar only: Nov 1–16, 2026 matches the supplied Sunday-through-Monday weekday pattern. The notes also said ‘Nov 2, 2006’; the year is not confirmed.
trip.provenance: The supplied 16-day outline covers Week 1 in Seoul Myeongdong (Days 1–8), the Seoul→Busan KTX transfer on Day 9 (printed at the end of Week 1 and repeated at the top of Week 2), Week 2 in Busan Haeundae (Days 10–15), and a Busan→Seoul KTX + AREX return to Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae on Day 16. Days 7, 8, 13 and 15 have no listed activities in the brief (Day 7 names Itaewon only). This field guide preserves that sequence except for a clearly marked Monday/Tuesday swap needed for Gyeongbokgung's Tuesday closure; optional suggestions on otherwise empty days are labeled editorial. No booking is established.

days.title: Land & settle in
days.subtitle: The notes suggest SFO to Incheon; keep the first evening light.

depart.text: The original notes describe SFO→ICN around Oct 31/Nov 1, but no actual flight or terminal is confirmed. If arriving at Incheon, Stanford's FAQ suggests airport bus 6015 to the Ibis Myeongdong stop and a walk to its Centerpoint Building entrance. AREX Express instead reaches Seoul Station, where onward local transport is needed. Confirm the live bus/rail service and flight before choosing.

stops.why: Find the 9th-floor lobby. Check-in starts at 15:00; ask about bags if you arrive sooner.
Stay near the hotel and browse only shops actually open that evening.

return.text: Walk back to Stanford using its official address; no room or arrival time has been confirmed for this trip.

days.note: Do not interpret the SFO/ICN route note as a purchased flight. Airport Express onboard time is not the total trip from aircraft to hotel.

days.title: A palace-day correction
days.subtitle: Move the original Tuesday palace and Bukchon visit to Monday.

depart.text: From Stanford's Euljiro 1-ga area (Line 2), ride to Euljiro 3-ga, change to Line 3 for Gyeongbokgung Station and use Exit 5. This Monday placement is an editorial correction; the submitted plan had the palace on Tuesday, its ordinary closed day.

stops.why: Regular Tuesdays are closed. November closing is 17:00, last entry 16:00; a specific 2026 ceremonial performance is not guaranteed.
Reach the Anguk side on foot or via Line 3. Restricted residential tourist lanes permit visits only 10:00–17:00; be quiet.
The operator-listed Anguk branch is near the palace district. Avoid promising a queue-free seat.

return.text: From Anguk, Line 3 to Euljiro 3-ga then Line 2 to Euljiro 1-ga; follow station signs back to Stanford.

days.note: The submitted Day 2 focused on Namsan and Myeongdong; those stops move to Tuesday in this source-backed swap. A changing-of-the-guard time for the proposed date has not been confirmed.

days.title: Namsan & Myeongdong
days.subtitle: Use the original Day 2 shopping and skyline ideas on Tuesday.

depart.text: From Stanford, walk toward Myeongdong Station (Line 4). The cable car operator gives a walking route from Exit 3 or the Namsan Ormi approach from Exit 4. For a bus alternative, the tower lists 01A/01B via Chungmuro. No hotel-to-tower duration is verified.

stops.why: Weather-dependent ride up Namsan. Its ticket does not include observatory admission.
Separate paid observatory, with weekday entry stopping before its 22:30 close.
Browse the shopping district; individual street-food and beauty-store hours are not shared district hours.
Use the operator calendar; do not save this branch for its listed Monday Nov 9 closure.
The VisitKorea listing identifies Myeongdong Town, not the unverified D176 branch.
MICHELIN lists the restaurant as Bib Gourmand, not starred.
If choosing the market instead of Myeongdong street food, take Line 2 toward Euljiro 4-ga. It is not in the same shopping block.

return.text: Myeongdong shops are near Stanford. If ending at Gwangjang, take Line 2 from Euljiro 4-ga back to Euljiro 1-ga. No late-night food-stall opening is assumed.

days.note: The submitted Tuesday palace slot conflicts with the palace's regular closure. This proposed switch keeps its Day 2 tower/shopping ideas, but all optional purchases and specific shop hours require fresh checks.

days.title: Seongsu, then DDP if time
days.subtitle: Keep the original design-and-café theme; treat DDP as a separate district.

depart.text: From Euljiro 1-ga use Line 2 to Seongsu Station. Walk between operator-listed Seongsu addresses; if adding DDP later, ride Line 2 to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Exit 1 instead of treating DDP as a Seongsu shop.

stops.why: A branch named in the notes. Weekday hours agree across officials; weekend opening is disputed and left unverified.
Use the official Seongsu Space address, not another ADERERROR shop format.
Takeaway salt bread; the tourism listing mentions queues and batch baking.
Visit Seoul lists a takeout-only Seongsu dessert shop at 43-1 Yeonmujang-gil; no dine-in tables.
MUSINSA STANDARD's official Seongsu store listing.
VisitKorea lists the specific N Seongsu branch; it is not the unverified Myeongdong D176 store.
Use the current 13 Yeonmujang 11-gil flagship address.
Dongdaemun Design Plaza is reached by Line 2; exhibitions have their own hours and admission.

return.text: From Seongsu or Dongdaemun History & Culture Park take Line 2 toward Euljiro 1-ga and walk to Stanford. Hanjungsun and Olive Young N Seongsu have specific tourism-listing addresses; other unverified merchant and photo-booth candidates remain on the review page.

days.note: This day includes the original DDP idea but not the incorrect idea that DDP is in Seongsu. Hanjungsun and Olive Young N Seongsu now have specific official tourism listings; the separate Rain Report Croissant and other unresolved shortlist items remain unasserted.

days.title: COEX & Gangnam
days.subtitle: A straightforward Line 2 day built around the submitted mall and photo stop.

depart.text: From Euljiro 1-ga ride Line 2 to Samseong. COEX directly connects at Exits 5/6. A submitted 47-minute door-to-door estimate has not been verified and is not repeated here.

stops.why: Mall hours do not establish the hours of every shop, aquarium or event.
Visit Seoul identifies the Psy Hand Statue within the WTC/COEX area; exact artwork hours are unverified.

return.text: Ride Line 2 from Samseong back toward Euljiro 1-ga and walk to Stanford; allow time for the real service on the day.

days.note: The named Soul Market pastry stop has no venue-specific official address or hours in this ledger. Leave it off a confirmed route until checked.

days.title: Insadong & Ikseon-dong
days.subtitle: Keep the original Day 6 hanok-lane theme without routing unverified cafés.

depart.text: From the hotel area at Euljiro 1-ga Line 2, change at Euljiro 3-ga to Line 3 for Anguk and walk toward Insa-dong. Continue toward Jongno 3-ga / Ikseon-dong on foot or use Line 3 for the one-station connection.

stops.why: Public shopping street; galleries and shops decide their own opening times.
Hanok alleys around Jongno 3-ga; do not borrow Bukchon's hours for another neighborhood.
Rain Report Rainbow is documented in Ikseon-dong. It is distinct from the unconfirmed Seongsu Croissant site.

return.text: From Jongno 3-ga, Line 1 to City Hall and Line 2 to Euljiro 1-ga, or walk if convenient. Check current subway routing before travel.

days.note: The notes also mention Chwihyang, Favorite of Ikseon and Jayeondo on Day 6. The first two lack venue-specific official verification; the confirmed Jayeondo branch is in Seongsu, not Ikseon.

days.title: Itaewon, left open
days.subtitle: The supplied outline names Itaewon but does not list any Day 7 activities.

depart.text: If you choose to explore the named district, from Euljiro 1-ga take Line 2 to Euljiro 3-ga, change to Line 3 for Yaksu and then Line 6 to Itaewon Exit 3. This wayfinding route is optional; no submitted appointment or venue is assumed.

stops.why: A flexible area walk, not a manufactured restaurant or event booking. The original Day 7 is only a heading.

return.text: Reverse the Line 6 → Line 3 at Yaksu → Line 2 at Euljiro 3-ga route to Euljiro 1-ga, or use live wayfinding if plans change.

days.note: The original plan provides no Itaewon times or businesses for this day. Nearby possibilities are not treated as traveler requests.

days.title: An unassigned Seoul day
days.subtitle: No Day 8 activities were supplied; keep this as a rest and preparation buffer.

depart.text: No destination is required by the source outline. If choosing Mangwon Market, use Euljiro 1-ga Line 2 to Hapjeong then Line 6 to Mangwon Exit 2. A different Sunday food-street option is Gwangjang via Line 2 Euljiro 4-ga; Gwangjang retail is closed on Sundays.

stops.why: An officially listed neighborhood market, not a stop submitted for Day 8. Stall schedules can differ.
Food street is listed open year-round; on Sunday, do not expect Gwangjang retail to be open.

return.text: Return to Stanford using the published metro map. Leave time to prepare for the proposed next-day Seoul Station rail departure; no KTX seat is confirmed.

days.note: These alternatives are editorial suggestions, not original Day 8 bookings. Rest instead if preferred. Do not treat two different markets as a required two-stop route.

days.title: Take the KTX to Haeundae
days.subtitle: Check out of Stanford, ride the KTX south to Busan, and settle into Haeundae for Week 2.

depart.text: Check out of Stanford by 12:00. From Euljiro 1-ga Line 2, change at City Hall to Line 1 for Seoul Station. Take a separately booked KORAIL train to Busan Station; no specific duration, fare, seat or departure is confirmed. At Busan Station take Metro Line 1 to Seomyeon, transfer to Line 2 for Haeundae, then use L7's published address for the final walk.

stops.why: L7 publishes 15:00 check-in. The name in the notes does not establish a reservation or early-room access.
A walkable food market in the Haeundae area; vendor menus, prices and individual hours vary.
A shoreline stroll, not a November swimming suggestion. The tourism listing's 09:00–18:00 hours have unspecified scope.

return.text: Use the published L7 address (55 Haeun-daero 570beon-gil) to walk back from the Haeundae beachfront and market. Day 9 is printed both at the end of Week 1 and at the top of Week 2 in the supplied brief and serves as the arrival base for Days 9–15.

days.note: The submitted 45-minute early KTX boarding rule and 2h45 journey estimate are not asserted as verified. Confirm train inventory, station/platform guidance and the Busan hotel reservation independently.

days.title: Haeundae, Dongbaek & Sky Capsule
days.subtitle: Walk the beachfront and Dongbaek Coastal Trail to Nurimaru, then ride the Sky Capsule to Cheongsapo.

depart.text: Start on foot from L7 Haeundae toward Haeundae Beach and the west-end Dongbaekseom peninsula (or use Line 2 Haeundae → Dongbaek Exit 1). After Nurimaru APEC House, head to the east end of Haeundae Beach for Blueline Park Mipo Station; the brief mentions taking a bus to Mipo, though Mipo is also walkable along the beachfront and no bus number or duration is verified.

stops.why: Walk the beachfront and nearby cafés/shops. The tourism listing's 09:00–18:00 hours have unspecified scope.

MICHELIN Guide Selected (not starred) beef rib restaurant opening at 11:30. Afternoon break hours conflict across official listings (14:00–17:00 daily vs 15:15–16:30 weekends), and the 'arrive 30 min early' tip is traveler advice.
Follow the 950 m Dongbaek Coastal Trail around Dongbaekseom Island (spelled 'Dongbaekseon' in the brief).
Free APEC summit pavilion inside Dongbaekseom. Closed first Monday of the month (Nov 10 is Tuesday); closing hour conflicts between 17:00 and 18:00 on official Visit Busan pages.

Ride Mipo → Cheongsapo (~30 min, 2 km). Operator sells one-way departures only, not a single round-trip Sky Capsule ticket; book both directions separately or return by Beach Train. Online release is Tuesdays at 07:00 four weeks ahead.
Walk the free curved overwater skywalk near Cheongsapo Port (09:00–18:00; weather permitting).
Optional coastal rail return from Cheongsapo to Mipo if not booking a separate return Sky Capsule.
Optional LCT observatory stop (also scheduled on Day 12 morning). Official adult price conflicts (₩29,000 vs ₩27,000); the brief's $17.59 Klook rate is unverified.
Dinner and evening browse around Haeundae Market; individual stall hours and prices vary.

return.text: From Mipo / BUSAN X the SKY or Haeundae Market, walk back along Haeundae Beach and Gunam-ro to L7 Haeundae.

days.note: The brief instructs travelers to 'book round trip tickets' on the Sky Capsule, but Haeundae Blueline Park sells Sky Capsule rides as one-way departures only (Mipo→Cheongsapo or Cheongsapo→Mipo). BUSAN X the SKY is listed both here as optional and on Day 12 at 10:00–11:30.

days.title: Gamcheon, Songdo & Nampo-dong
days.subtitle: Hillside alleys in Gamcheon, the overwater skywalk and cable car at Songdo, and old downtown markets.

depart.text: The brief mentions taking '2 buses (1 hr & 17 min)' to Gamcheon without route numbers. The verified rail-and-bus route from L7 Haeundae is Metro Line 2 Haeundae → Seomyeon, transfer to Line 1 Seomyeon → Toseong Station Exit 6, then village bus Saha 1-1, Seo-gu 2 or Seo-gu 2-2 up to Gamcheon Culture Village.

stops.why: Wander the hillside alleys, viewpoints and shops. Visitor facilities operate 09:00–17:00 in Nov–Feb; respect residential quiet rules.
Descend from Gamcheon toward Nampo/Jagalchi for street food at BIFF Square (also revisited in the late-afternoon downtown loop).
Walk from BIFF Square to Jagalchi Fish Market. Two Visit Busan pages disagree on whether fifth Tuesdays are closed (Nov 11 is a Wednesday); the brief's '9 min. walk' is unverified.
From Jagalchi Station Exit 2 take Bus 7, 26, 30, 71 or 96 to Songdo Beach. The brief's '13 min bus ride, 9 min walk' is unverified.
Walk the free Songdo Cloud Trails overwater skywalk (06:00–23:00; weather permitting).
Optional Songdo Marine Cable Car (Busan Air Cruise, 09:00–21:00; Air Cruise ₩17,000 RT, Crystal ₩22,000 RT per adult).
Return to old downtown for Gukje Market (spelled 'Gukje Marker' in the brief; 09:00–20:00, closed Sundays, varies by shop).
Browse Nampo-dong shopping streets (Gwangbok-ro Fashion Street) alongside BIFF Square and Jagalchi.

return.text: From Nampo Station or Jagalchi Station take Metro Line 1 to Seomyeon, transfer to Line 2 for Haeundae Station, and walk to L7 Haeundae.

days.note: The brief names 'Coffee It House (2 minute walk)' near Gamcheon, which has no official tourism or operator listing and stays on the unverified shortlist. Note that the brief visits BIFF Square and Jagalchi before Songdo and lists them again in the late-afternoon downtown block, plus ends with a blank item '9.'.

days.title: BUSAN X the SKY & SEA LIFE Aquarium
days.subtitle: High-rise coastal views at LCT Landmark Tower followed by the Haeundae beachfront aquarium.

depart.text: Walk from L7 Haeundae along the beachfront toward the east end of Haeundae Beach (30 Dalmaji-gil) for BUSAN X the SKY at Haeundae LCT Landmark Tower.

stops.why: Observatory on floors 98–100 of Haeundae LCT Landmark Tower (spelled 'LCT Landmaek Tower' in the brief). Operating hours 10:00–21:00 (last entry 20:30) match the brief; adult KRW price conflicts (₩29,000 vs ₩27,000).
The brief leaves breakfast, beachfront lunch and shopping open around Haeundae Beach.
SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium at 266 Haeundaehaebyeon-ro. Weekday hours 10:00–19:00 (last entry 18:00) match the brief; the '$15 ticket' claim is unverified.
The brief leaves '5. Dinner:' blank; Haeundae Market is the nearby sourced evening food street.

return.text: Walk from SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium (266 Haeundaehaebyeon-ro) back to L7 Haeundae (55 Haeun-daero 570beon-gil).

days.note: Breakfast, lunch and the trailing '5. Dinner:' line on Day 12 are unspecified in the supplied brief. Confirm aquarium ticket pricing on the operator checkout rather than relying on the '$15' note.

days.title: Busan Friday, left open
days.subtitle: The supplied outline includes a Day 13 Friday heading with no listed activities.

depart.text: No destination was submitted for Day 13. If choosing an optional east-coast outing from L7 Haeundae, walk to Haeundae Station Exit 7 and board city bus 181, 100 or Haeundae 9 toward Haedong Yonggungsa Temple.

stops.why: Not in the submitted brief; included only as a sourced optional Busan coastal stop if you want to fill the blank Friday (04:30–19:20, last entry 18:50, free).
Keep the day as a rest buffer around Haeundae Beach if preferred.

return.text: Return by bus 181, 100 or Haeundae 9 to Haeundae Station and walk back to L7 Haeundae.

days.note: Day 13 in the supplied itinerary is a blank heading ('Day 13: Friday'). Any stop shown here is an optional editorial suggestion, not a confirmed traveler plan.

days.title: Gwangalli Beach & Drone Light Show
days.subtitle: An open daytime followed by a 17:00 arrival at Gwangalli Beach for the 19:00 winter drone show.

depart.text: Daytime before 17:00 is left open in the brief. For the 17:00 evening plan, walk from L7 Haeundae to Haeundae Station and ride Busan Metro Line 2 five stops west to Gwangan Station (Exit 5), then walk about 13 minutes to Gwangalli Beach.

stops.why: Arrive at Gwangalli Beach (spelled 'Gwangali' in the brief) for an early dinner or snack and a beachfront viewing spot.
Gwangalli M Drone Light Show winter schedule (Oct–Feb) runs Saturdays at 19:00 and 21:00. Visit Busan notes ~10 minutes per show (brief says 12 minutes); subject to weather cancellation.

return.text: Walk from Gwangalli Beach back to Gwangan Station (Exit 5) and ride Metro Line 2 east to Haeundae Station for L7 Haeundae.

days.note: No daytime activities before 17:00 or specific Gwangalli dinner restaurant were supplied. Always recheck the Suyeong-gu / Gwangalli drone show notice on the day of travel, as wind or rain can cancel or reschedule performances.

days.title: Busan Sunday, left open
days.subtitle: The supplied outline includes a Day 15 Sunday heading with no listed activities before Monday's train north.

depart.text: No destination was submitted for Day 15. Keep the day open near Haeundae or, for an optional evening market visit, ride Line 2 Haeundae → Seomyeon and Line 1 Seomyeon → Jagalchi Exit 3 for Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market (note Gukje Market retail is closed Sundays).

stops.why: Unassigned Sunday in the brief; stay near Haeundae and prepare for Monday's 11:00 hotel checkout if preferred.
Editorial option not in the submitted brief: Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market operates 19:30–00:00 daily except traditional holidays.

return.text: Return to L7 Haeundae via Metro Line 1 → Seomyeon → Line 2 Haeundae and prepare for Monday's checkout before 11:00.

days.note: Day 15 in the supplied itinerary is a blank heading ('Day 15: Sunday'). Confirm Monday KTX return tickets and pack before the 11:00 L7 checkout.

days.title: Return KTX to Seoul & Hongdae
days.subtitle: Check out of L7 Haeundae by 11:00, take the KTX to Seoul Station, and ride the AREX All-Stop train to Hongik Univ. Station.
days.overnight: Seoul Hongdae · Mercure reservation not confirmed

depart.text: Check out of L7 Haeundae before 11:00 (matches Lotte's published 11:00 checkout). The brief suggests an Uber to Busan Station ('1 hour ride, $20-$30', duration and fare unverified); the public-transit alternative is Busan Metro Line 2 Haeundae → Seomyeon, transfer to Line 1 Seomyeon → Busan Station. Take a separately booked KTX train to Seoul Station, then board the AREX All-Stop Train (일반열차) two stops to Hongik Univ. Station (AREX Express runs non-stop to Incheon Airport and does NOT stop at Hongik Univ.).

stops.why: Published check-out is by 11:00. Breakfast venue and the '1 hour / $20–$30' Uber estimate to Busan Station are unverified.
Exit 9 at Hongik Univ. Station. Accor lists a 2-minute (100 m) walk to 144 Yanghwa-ro, conflicting with the brief's '8 minute walk'; check-in starts at 15:00.

return.text: Arrive at Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae (144 Yanghwa-ro, Mapo-gu) via Hongik Univ. Station Exit 9. No onward airport transfer or departure flight after Day 16 is supplied in the brief.

days.note: Critical rail note: at Seoul Station, use the AREX All-Stop Train (일반열차) to reach Hongik Univ. Station — the AREX Express Train is non-stop to Incheon Airport and skips Hongdae. No KTX ticket, Mercure hotel booking, or post-Day-16 flight home is confirmed.
